scripts.build: npm run build -w @slotbook/shared && npm run build -w @slotbook/api && npm run build -w @slotbook/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @slotbook/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @slotbook/api" "npm run dev -w @slotbook/web"
scripts.test: npm run build -w @slotbook/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
